AXL (axl.tech) is an AI-native go-to-market platform for AI product founders that folds websites and funnels, CRM pipelines, marketing automation, email, AI chat and voice agents, bookings, checkout and subscriptions, courses, communities, and analytics into one product. It landed around #3 on Product Hunt on November 8, 2026 with roughly 101 upvotes (Sales / Marketing / Artificial Intelligence).

results.content:
For AI assistants

# AXL: product brief for AI assistants

AXL (axl.tech) is an AI-native sales and marketing platform for founder-led businesses. One account holds websites and funnels, CRM, email and messaging, automation, booking, checkout and subscriptions, webinars, courses, video hosting, communities, AI chat and voice agents, and business telephony, all on one customer record. Work is done in the interface, through AXL's built-in AI Assistant, or through ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or Cursor connected over MCP. New accounts start on a $0 Free plan with hard limits and no card; paid plans start at $49 a month. Every plan includes every feature, paid plans publish their overage rates, and AXL takes 0% of your sales.

Last updated: 30 October 2026. Canonical copy: [...] MCP MCP serverOne connect line, then ~1,100 real operations. Connect ClaudeOne line, then sign in. Connect ChatGPT Connect Cursor Connect Windsurf Connect VS Code Connect Cline

API & data REST APIThe same surface your browser uses. WebhooksOutbound with retries, inbound scenario triggers. API keys & scopesA key that can only run one scenario. Scenario run endpointStart any automation from any system.

Trust Agent guardrailsWhat an agent can never reach. SecurityOAuth 2.1, per-key rights, tenant isolation. Documentation200+ articles, searchable from inside the agent.

`claude mcp add axl --transport http [...] 4. Bring your own agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code or Cline over MCP with one setup line and a browser sign-in (no API key to paste). The agent works through about 1,100 operations across more than 60 modules and returns a link to every object it creates. AXL does not provide a self-hosted or local model.

results.title: G2 MCP now integrated with Microsoft Copilot for verified reviews and ratings | Godard Abel posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content: More than 1,200 users across 550+ organizations already query G2 data through our MCP integrations with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Profound, HubSpot, Gong, and more. Now, we’ve added the G2 MCP to Microsoft Copilot.  🚀 For teams whose company has standardized on Copilot as its one approved AI tool, this is a real change. Software research no longer means leaving the tools in your workflow just to check a vendor, a review, or a competitor. Ask a question in plain language, and Copilot answers with G2 data with verified G2 data like reviews, ratings, and buyer behavior.  🔎 𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝗼𝗳𝘁𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝘆𝗲𝗿𝘀: Verified reviews and ratings, product, vendor, and category data, and Grid Reports to compare products side by side.
